title: Geometry-Interaction Affordance Reasoning Lineage

route_narrowing.user_direction: Build a technical lineage map from the baseline paper arXiv:2602.20501.

routes.label: Affordance Grounding Benchmarks
routes.description: Papers that define visual affordance grounding as localization and establish exocentric-to-egocentric evaluation anchors.

routes.label: Part And Dense Geometry Priors
routes.description: Papers showing that self-supervised visual features expose object parts, dense correspondences, and reusable geometry priors.

routes.label: Open And Language-Guided Affordance
routes.description: Papers that use foundation models or language knowledge to generalize affordance grounding beyond fixed closed-set supervision.

routes.label: Generative Interaction Cues
routes.description: Papers that make generative models relevant as action- or instruction-conditioned spatial priors rather than pure recognition encoders.

routes.label: VFM Probing And Bridging
routes.description: Papers that probe what visual foundation models encode, then bridge geometry and interaction cues into an affordance reasoning account.

papers.title: Learning Affordance Grounding from Exocentric Images
papers.source_evidence: arXiv abstract defines affordance grounding from exocentric to egocentric images and introduces AGD20K with over 20K images across 36 affordance categories.
papers.summary: Establishes the core visual affordance grounding task and AGD20K benchmark that later project papers use as the main localization/evaluation frame.

papers.title: Deep ViT Features as Dense Visual Descriptors
papers.source_evidence: arXiv abstract reports that self-supervised DINO-ViT features encode localized object-part semantics and cross-category correspondences usable for zero-shot co-segmentation and semantic correspondence.
papers.summary: Provides the early dense-feature premise: frozen self-supervised ViT features can expose object parts and correspondences without task-specific affordance training.

papers.title: LOCATE: Localize and Transfer Object Parts for Weakly Supervised Affordance Grounding
papers.source_evidence: arXiv abstract says LOCATE identifies matching object parts across exocentric interaction images and egocentric test images using only image-level affordance and object labels.
papers.summary: Moves the grounding route from dataset/task framing toward explicit object-part transfer, making parts a central affordance localization mechanism.

papers.title: DINOv2: Learning Robust Visual Features without Supervision
papers.source_evidence: arXiv abstract states DINOv2 produces all-purpose visual features that work across image distributions and tasks without finetuning, including image and pixel-level benchmarks.
papers.summary: Scales the dense self-supervised feature route from DINO-ViT descriptors into a general-purpose VFM backbone used by later affordance work.

papers.title: One-Shot Open Affordance Learning with Foundation Models
papers.source_evidence: arXiv abstract introduces one-shot open affordance learning and says VLMs often struggle with fine-grained affordance understanding, motivating a framework that aligns visual features and affordance text embeddings.
papers.summary: Shows that open-vocabulary affordance is not solved by generic VLM semantics; fine-grained affordance grounding still needs visual-part alignment.

papers.title: Probing the 3D Awareness of Visual Foundation Models
papers.source_evidence: arXiv abstract frames task-specific probes and zero-shot procedures on frozen features to test whether VFMs encode 3D scene structure and consistent surfaces across views.
papers.summary: Adds the probing methodology and boundary language needed before claiming that VFM representations encode affordance-relevant geometry.

papers.title: AffordanceLLM: Grounding Affordance from Vision Language Models
papers.source_evidence: arXiv abstract argues affordance grounding needs object/part, layout, 3D, physics, function, and human-object-interaction knowledge and uses pretrained VLM knowledge for generalization.
papers.summary: Represents the language/world-knowledge route: use VLM priors to expand affordance grounding beyond narrow supervised labels.

papers.title: Perception Encoder: The best visual embeddings are not at the output of the network
papers.source_evidence: arXiv abstract says contrastive vision-language training can produce strong general embeddings for spatial tasks, but those embeddings are hidden in intermediate layers and need language/spatial alignment.
papers.summary: Strengthens the representation-probing route: affordance-relevant spatial signals may live in intermediate VFM layers rather than final global embeddings.

papers.title: FLUX.1 Kontext: Flow Matching for In-Context Image Generation and Editing in Latent Space
papers.source_evidence: arXiv abstract presents FLUX.1 Kontext as a flow matching model that uses text and image inputs as semantic context for unified generation and editing.
papers.summary: Not an affordance method by itself, but supplies the generative, instruction-conditioned model family whose attention maps the baseline treats as interaction priors.

papers.title: DINOv3
papers.source_evidence: arXiv abstract says DINOv3 produces high-quality dense features and outperforms prior self- and weakly-supervised foundation models across many vision tasks without fine-tuning.
papers.summary: Supplies the latest dense-feature geometry backbone in the baseline paper's DINO-side argument.

papers.title: Probing and Bridging Geometry-Interaction Cues for Affordance Reasoning in Vision Foundation Models
papers.source_evidence: arXiv abstract argues affordance understanding hinges on geometry and interaction perception, reports DINO part-level structure and Flux verb-conditioned attention maps, and fuses them in a training-free zero-shot affordance estimator.
papers.summary: Sits at the convergence point: converts grounding, dense geometry, VLM/open-affordance, and generative interaction cues into a probe-and-bridge account.

explicit_edges.rationale: LOCATE keeps the exocentric-to-egocentric affordance grounding setup but shifts the mechanism toward object-part localization and transfer.
explicit_edges.source_evidence: Both arXiv abstracts frame affordance grounding from exocentric interaction images to egocentric object images; LOCATE explicitly adds object-part transfer.

explicit_edges.rationale: DINOv2 scales the self-supervised ViT feature route from dense descriptors into robust all-purpose visual features at image and pixel levels.
explicit_edges.source_evidence: Amir2021 establishes DINO-ViT dense descriptors; DINOv2's arXiv abstract emphasizes scalable all-purpose features and pixel-level benchmarks.

explicit_edges.rationale: DINOv3 extends the DINO self-supervised route with stronger dense features and larger-scale foundation-model behavior.
explicit_edges.source_evidence: DINOv3 arXiv abstract explicitly positions itself as surpassing previous self- and weakly-supervised foundation models with high-quality dense features.

explicit_edges.rationale: OOAL emphasizes visual-feature/text-embedding alignment under one-shot supervision, while AffordanceLLM emphasizes world and human-object-interaction knowledge from VLMs.
explicit_edges.source_evidence: Their arXiv abstracts state different routes to open affordance: one-shot visual-text alignment versus VLM knowledge transfer.

explicit_edges.rationale: The baseline adapts Flux-style instruction-conditioned generative behavior from image generation/editing into affordance interaction priors.
explicit_edges.source_evidence: FLUX.1 Kontext source describes text/image semantic context; the baseline arXiv abstract describes Flux verb-conditioned spatial attention maps as implicit interaction priors.

explicit_edges.rationale: The baseline adapts DINO dense geometry into affordance-region estimation by fusing geometric prototypes with interaction maps.
explicit_edges.source_evidence: DINOv3 source describes dense feature quality; the baseline source says DINO geometric prototypes are fused with Flux interaction maps.

explicit_edges.rationale: Both use probing to ask what VFMs internally encode, but the baseline narrows the probe to affordance-relevant geometry and interaction cues.
explicit_edges.source_evidence: Banani2024 source frames frozen-feature probes for geometry; the baseline source frames systematic probing of VFMs for affordance reasoning.

positioning_note: Starting from arXiv:2602.20501, the field shape is not a simple citation chain. The baseline paper sits at a convergence of four paper routes: AGD20K/LOCATE define affordance grounding as localized action-region transfer; Amir-DINOv2-DINOv3 provide dense part/geometry priors; OOAL/AffordanceLLM test open and language-guided affordance generalization; FLUX.1 Kontext supplies the generative model family whose instruction-conditioned spatial behavior can be reinterpreted as interaction cues. The project contribution is the bridge: treat geometry and interaction as separable VFM capacities, then compose them in a training-free affordance estimator.
